# Gnomcode — The Runtime for AI Coding Agents

> Gnomcode is a local-first runtime, model orchestrator, and encrypted remote control for AI coding agents on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

## Core Capabilities
- **Model Switching**: Switch mid-conversation between Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and Gemini CLI. Compiles objectives, changed files, and recent turns into a local handoff.
- **Mobile Remote Companion**: Pair your phone with your desktop daemon to read conversations, respond to approval prompts, and send follow-up instructions over an end-to-end encrypted channel.
- **Fleet HUD & Usage Tracking**: Unified tracking of tokens, spend, and quota pools across all agents with declared trust levels (exact, estimated, api, unknown).
- **Fail-Open & Local-First**: The daemon runs on loopback (127.0.0.1). Redacted history remains local on your machine. Zero telemetry or phone-home.

## Supported Agents
- Anthropic Claude Code (`claude`)
- OpenAI Codex (`codex`)
- Google Antigravity (`agy`)
- Google Gemini CLI (`gemini`)
- Cline & Roo Code
- Cursor
- Aider (opt-in)

## Official Documentation & Guides
- [Getting Started](https://gnomcode.vercel.app/docs/getting-started): Installation, system requirements, and initial setup.
- [Supported Agents](https://gnomcode.vercel.app/docs/supported-agents): Full agent capability and observation matrix.
- [Model Switching](https://gnomcode.vercel.app/docs/model-switching): How handoffs compile conversation context and file changes.
- [Prompt from Phone](https://gnomcode.vercel.app/docs/prompt-from-phone): Pairing mobile devices with Gnomcode Remote over encrypted WebRTC/relay.
- [Model Pricing & Quota](https://gnomcode.vercel.app/docs/model-pricing): Cost calculations, rate limit resets, and trust levels.
- [FAQ](https://gnomcode.vercel.app/docs/faq): Frequently asked questions on security, subscriptions, and integrations.

## Progressive Web App & Remote
- Web Application: https://gnomcode.vercel.app/remote
- Mobile PWA: Installable directly from browser on iOS and Android with background notifications for agent completion and approval requests.
